**🔒 Security & Privacy** | **🟠 Major** | **🏗️ Heavy lift**

**Do not make worldwide routing the implicit default.**

If a user selects an EU region and leaves `model_id` unchanged, this global profile can process prompts and outputs outside the EU. AWS recommends a geographic profile when data residency matters. Add a geography-bound option and require an explicit choice for global routing, or make the default region-aware. ([docs.aws.amazon.com](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_en/bedrock/latest/userguide/cross-region-inference.html?utm_source=openai))
